title: Pocketwire Advance Terms — Conditions of Disbursement
content:
These terms govern when a Pocketwire Advance can be disbursed, where it goes and when it falls due.

**1. Line status.** An advance can be disbursed only while the line status is active, so no new advance is possible while any advance is past due or the line is suspended. This is read from the system record of the line's status.

**2. Personal account and destination.** The linked Pocketwire Personal Account must be active or limited for a delivery to the personal balance, and a delivery to an external debit card is possible only where the tier's allowed destinations list it. No advance is disbursed while the personal account is locked or closed.

**3. Wait after a full repayment.** After an advance is repaid in full, the next one waits the tier's number of full hours after a full repayment.

**4. Due date and delivery.** The due date is the tier's repayment term in calendar days after the disbursement date. A delivery to the personal balance is immediate and free; a standard delivery to an external debit card costs the tier's standard delivery fee and arrives within the tier's standard delivery business days; express delivery arrives within the tier's express delivery minutes for the express fee.

**5. The customer's decision.** Requesting an advance is the customer's own borrowing decision and is confirmed by the customer in the app.

**6. Retired clause.** The following clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current Pocketwire Advance basis for the amount of a new advance:

> *No longer in force:* "The amount is at least the smallest advance and a whole multiple of the advance increment, within the rules on advances outstanding and the effective limit."

## Line status and disbursement

| Line status | Term 1 |
|---|---|
| active | Met |
| applied | Not met — no disbursement |
| past due | Not met — no disbursement |
| suspended | Not met — no disbursement |
| closed | Not met — no disbursement |

## Personal account status and destination

| Personal account status | Delivery to the personal balance | Delivery to an external debit card |
|---|---|---|
| active | Term 2 met | Only where the tier's allowed destinations list it |
| limited | Term 2 met | Only where the tier's allowed destinations list it |
| locked | No advance is disbursed | No advance is disbursed |
| closed | No advance is disbursed | No advance is disbursed |

## Worked due date (hypothetical)

An advance disbursed on 10 March on a line on Pocketwire Advance Basic, whose repayment term is 21 calendar days, falls due on 31 March. The same advance on Pocketwire Advance Standard, with a term of 28 calendar days, falls due on 7 April.

superseded_clauses: The amount is at least min_advance_amount and a whole multiple of advance_increment, within advance_agg_outstanding.
